maxhodak.en: Early: speed and iteration are key; AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 早期（2026-08）：强调速度和迭代决定成败；AI 是团队的倍增器，而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: Later: brain is a computer; BCIs restore vision and prove substrate independence.
maxhodak.zh: 后期（2026-08）：认为大脑是计算机；脑机接口可恢复视觉并证明基质独立性。

maxhodak.en: Consistent: computational view of biology and technology; action produces information.
maxhodak.zh: 始终：坚持生物学和技术的计算视角；行动产生信息。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries.
traviskalanick.zh: 将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理，是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode lets companies focus on internal correctness, avoiding external validation; a cultural advantage.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式让公司专注于内部正确性，而非外部认可，这是一种文化优势。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution, automating food, mining, transport; fight for the best idea.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，将自动化食品、采矿、运输等行业；要为最好的想法而战。

traviskalanick.en: Entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient; resistance to change is the final boss, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 创业者必须硬核且有韧性；变革阻力是最终 BOSS，而非竞争对手。

traviskalanick.en: Media landscape changed; founders can communicate directly, bypassing traditional gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 媒体格局已变，创始人可以直接沟通，绕开传统守门人。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product; design should leverage tokens and conversation over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，将模型视为核心产品；设计应利用 token 和对话而非像素。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类对于理解用户需求和拥有观点仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key to success.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不可行；借助 AI 工具的速度和快速迭代是成功关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles will blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色将与产品和工程融合，但专业化角色在大规模下仍有价值；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives a leg up due to early AI evolution; embrace building in public and adaptability.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；由于 AI 发展尚早，现在开始反而占优；拥抱公开构建和适应性。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年，我认为仅靠规模不足以实现通用机器人，关键在于多样化数据以及预训练加微调。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年，语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循指令，这类似于强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI demands near-zero errors; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，物理 AI 要求极低错误率，通过可扩展强化学习和多尺度记忆实现长期自主至关重要。

finn.en: A single generalist model can outperform fine-tuned specialists, shifting from per-site training to generalist fine-tuning.
finn.zh: 2026 年，单一通用模型可超越微调专家，从逐站点训练转向通用模型微调。

finn.en: Diverse data and detailed prompting are consistently crucial for compositional generalization in robotics.
finn.zh: 始终，多样化数据和详细提示对机器人组合泛化至关重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety through control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；试图控制 AI 的安全努力本身是危险的。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and no domain knowledge.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI 需要通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习，具备开放式抽象，不依赖领域知识。

sutton.en: Continual learning from experience is essential; current LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续从经验学习至关重要，当前 LLM 训练后不再学习；合成数据是错误方向。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing need for large capital; VC should be abundant with many billion-dollar companies.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是决定性因素；风投应更充裕，支持更多十亿美元级公司而非少数万亿级巨头。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，Gary 强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型制衡前沿实验室；小规模自主团队借助智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; open-source prevents unipolar superintelligence; AI progresses slower than researchers think.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，Gary 认为 AI 正民主化软件开发，开源防止超级智能被垄断；同时指出 AI 进展比研究者预期慢，影响才刚开始。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure with owned memory; skill files in markdown turn agents into employees.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Gary 提出个人 AGI 概念：运行在自有基础设施上的智能体，拥有记忆；Markdown 技能文件将智能体转化为员工。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; mid-level management replaced by agents; society changes slowly.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，Gary 强调智能体式编程大幅提升产出；SaaS 按席位模式可能消失；中层管理被智能体取代；社会变革缓慢但积极。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence will dominate; AGI as a single model is wrong. Every company will own its own models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张专用智能将主导，单一 AGI 模型是错误的，每家公司都将拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable AI businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models, reducing costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久 AI 业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型，成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training creates a moat, and incumbents also face scaling risks.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性，后训练构建护城河，现有企业也面临规模扩张风险。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方仲裁，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: The biggest AI risk is programming it to lie for political correctness; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克指出 AI 最大风险是出于政治正确而撒谎，并认为人口崩溃是文明最大威胁。

elon.en: AI could surpass human intelligence by 2026; probability of annihilation is 10-20%, but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克预测 AI 可能在 2026 年超越人类智能，认为毁灭概率 10-20%，但 80-90%是好的结果。

elon.en: AI compute scaling hits power wall on Earth; space-based AI data centers will be cheapest and most scalable within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克认为地球算力扩张遭遇电力瓶颈，太空 AI 数据中心将在 36 个月内成为最便宜且可扩展的方案。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，陈立武强调 AI 是半导体的主要增长引擎，英特尔需以专用芯片重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，陈立武指出生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，需要新的计算平台。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, customer focus, and humility; bad news must reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，陈立武强调英特尔转型需文化变革、客户导向和谦逊，坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; AI demand shifts to CPU+GPU.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，陈立武认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中愈发重要，AI 需求正转向 CPU+GPU。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits in semiconductors.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，陈立武强调先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是突破半导体物理极限的关键。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; never revert code, fix forward; vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体共情；不要回退代码，而是向前修复；‘氛围编程’是贬义词。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; open source financially unsustainable; model intelligence doesn't degrade.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，指出 OpenClaw 成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；开源财务上不可持续；模型智能不会退化。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand > product; open source alternative to lab agents; compute bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌比产品更重要；开源是实验室智能体的替代；算力是瓶颈。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven, improve better, test new ideas; new ideas usually fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出“Proven Better New”框架：复制已被验证的模式，做更好的改进，再测试新想法；新想法通常失败。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet opportunity is huge; enterprise sees no AI benefit due to skill gap.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大；企业未看到 AI 收益是技能问题而非技术问题。

pincus.en: Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调消费应用因分发难题不可投资，企业和专业消费者市场机会更好。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water over the right boat; invest in traction.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调分发是根本，选择正确的“水域”比“船”更重要；投资于有牵引力的公司。

pincus.en: Consumer AI TAM underestimated; AI infrastructure spending may be short-term bubble; broken internet stocks are buys.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为消费级 AI 市场被低估；AI 基础设施支出短期或成泡沫；受损的互联网股票是买入机会。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正推理，应以人为中心的 AI 增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness; world models must be physically plausible, not just realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，世界模型需物理合理而非仅逼真。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她认为 AI 需超越 Scaling，具备创造力、抽象和情商，世界模型支持 3D 推理。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics; world models need spatial-temporal consistency, not perfect fidelity.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调仿真对机器人关键，世界模型需时空一致性而非完美保真。

feifei.en: AI augments human agency; education must teach AI use, not ban it; spatial intelligence is next frontier.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她重申 AI 增强人类能动性，教育应教使用而非禁止，空间智能是下一前沿。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection point; open source crucial for safety; data diversity main bottleneck; world models generate synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈；世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer; RL environments increase reward hacking.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全正交；对齐是关键安全层；强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客行为。

thomaswolf.en: First autonomous AI attack by closed model, defended by open one; closed models less controllable than assumed.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御；闭源模型可控性低于预期。

thomaswolf.en: Model reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor; open source models less deceptive; support openness and slowdown.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，模型推理痕迹变得像“神经语”，难以监控；开源模型欺骗性较低；支持开放与减速并行。

karina.en: Post-training is art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据墙。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills and prototyping with AI become key as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025→26 年：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能和 AI 原型设计成为关键。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年：基准必须持续更新而非固定，以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Models can have diverse personalities; reward hacking grows with capability.
karina.zh: 2026 年：模型可以有多种个性；奖励黑客随能力增长。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload; inference engineering is a complex discipline with fast research-to-production timelines.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理是 AI 中最重要且粘性最强的工作负载；推理工程是一门复杂学科，研究到生产的周期极快。

philipkiely.en: Specialized inference systems are crucial for agentic apps; demand for inference engineers will grow 10-100x, even with AI coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月：专用推理系统对智能体应用至关重要；即使有 AI 编程，推理工程师需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization is merging with training; techniques like quantization-aware training and distillation are becoming necessary.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：推理优化正与训练融合；量化感知训练和蒸馏等技术变得必要。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs are becoming ASIC-like, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：未来 GPU 正趋于 ASIC 化，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: KV cache compaction may solve continual learning better than weight updates, avoiding reasoning inconsistencies.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月：KV 缓存压缩可能比权重更新更好地解决持续学习，避免推理不一致。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; individual designer fingerprints and playful tech tinkering drive innovation.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型设计在浏览器设计中的必要性，允许设计师留下个人印记，并通过趣味性技术探索驱动创新。

nateparrott.en: Anthropomorphizing AI tools with names and faces reminds users of their fallibility and biases.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，提出给 AI 工具赋予名字和面孔，有助于提醒用户其易错性和偏见。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a side project; rich context and prescriptive prompts yield better design results.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Claude Design 从个人副业项目起步，强调提供丰富上下文和明确指令以获得更好的设计效果。

nateparrott.en: As engineering becomes easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping enables new features.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，随着工程难度降低，设计和创意成为差异化因素；快速原型使新功能成为可能。

nateparrott.en: Models lack good taste; designers should request volume and focus on ideas, not execution.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，模型缺乏良好审美，设计师应追求数量并聚焦于创意而非执行。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality are not ideal for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出 LLM 可从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligence; aligning such societies requires economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AGI 可能是分布式专业智能体社会，而非单一超级智能；对齐此类社会需要经济激励和反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rationality; the goal is shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟模型应体现人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性；目标是塑造未来，而不仅是预测。

joonpark.en: Synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years; a single simulation session could cost $100 million.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，预测合成面板将在三年内超过人类面板规模；单次模拟会话可能耗资 1 亿美元。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key; hardware like TPUs is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键，专用硬件如 TPU 至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; inference latency becomes critical; data not running out, pre-training should include action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务，推理延迟成为关键；数据并未枯竭，预训练应包含行动交互。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; automating ML and science via loops; context engineering central; inference bottleneck; startups should target hard problems.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，自动化 ML 和科学实验循环是趋势，上下文工程至关重要，推理是瓶颈，创业应瞄准前沿模型失败的问题。

awang.en: AI is bigger than the internet; data is the key bottleneck; AGI is far off; self-driving will be safer than humans.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为 AI 比互联网更重大，数据是关键瓶颈；AGI 还很遥远，自动驾驶将比人类更安全。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is key; hybrid human-AI systems create more value.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油；后训练结合专家数据是关键；人机混合系统创造更大价值。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; no US-China research gap; agentic AI's blocker is product design, not capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调后训练与专用数据的重要性；认为中美研究无差距；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非能力。

awang.en: AI is centralizing power; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are necessary.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我警告 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油；人类须保持主权，脑机接口成为必要。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进开启新范式，智能体已实用；超级智能临近，开源强大模型不安全。

tworek.en: Reasoning via chain of thought and RLHF were key to GPT-4; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：思维链和 RLHF 对 GPT-4 至关重要；扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't yield AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing, and societal risk is dystopia, not extinction.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：仅靠扩展强化学习无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错缺失，社会风险是反乌托邦而非灭绝。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures and better learning algorithms are needed for continual learning and AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 成为瓶颈；需要新架构和更好的学习算法以实现持续学习和 AGI。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress, RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；监督学习推动进展，强化学习实际应用少。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是瓶颈；开放权重模型增强地缘政治影响力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but shifted to synthetic data and RL.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；缩放定律仍有效，但转向合成数据和强化学习。

andrewng.en: Coding agents advance fast; product management bottleneck worsens; AI won't cause mass unemployment.
andrewng.zh: 编程智能体进展快；产品管理瓶颈加剧；AI 不会导致大规模失业。

mengto.en: AI won't get smarter; you must craft giant prompts with context and design systems to unlock superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: 2026 年中，他认为 AI 不会变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词才能解锁超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Shift from building tools to seizing AI opportunity: start before ready, ship imperfect, focus on one problem.
mengto.zh: 从 6 月到 7 月，观点从工具构建转向抓住 AI 机遇：在准备好之前就开始、发布不完美的作品、聚焦单一问题。

mengto.en: AI lets one person do what teams did; the safe corporate job is gone, so offense is the real low-risk move.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调 AI 让单个人完成过去团队的工作，安全的企业工作已不存在，主动出击才是真正的低风险选择。

mengto.en: Consistently anti-perfectionism: launch at 80%, iterate from feedback, and avoid overthinking as a blocker.
mengto.zh: 始终反对完美主义：以 80% 完成度发布，根据反馈迭代，避免过度思考成为阻碍。

mengto.en: Always prioritize giving value first, building relationships, and modeling success rather than reinventing.
mengto.zh: 始终优先给予价值、建立关系、模仿成功模式，而非重新发明轮子。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still in crawl phase; coding agents are most mature, narrow superintelligence in coding already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编码智能体最成熟，编码领域的狭义超级智能已经到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞噬脚手架；模型现在包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success metric is customer outcomes.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索和参与度是正和而非蚕食；成功指标是客户成果。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人应专注于机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less; deep code understanding still crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建基本解决，带来更多而非更少机会；深度代码理解仍然至关重要。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年：聚焦重要问题、减少认知负荷；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，应在人际关系与创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年：RLHF 用少量数据实现对齐；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 2024 年：算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争需细致看待。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: 2025 年：AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型因思考时间而改进。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; robotics essential; startups more important; compute uncapped demand.
altman.zh: 2026 年：预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；具身机器人至关重要；初创企业更重要；算力需求无上限。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture and oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构与监督。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突变；产品创新滞后于能力，冻结模型仍可带来十年进展。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍，生产力按成果而非 token 衡量，丰裕时代临近。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 2025 年底，Boris 强调产品开发的核心是发现潜在需求，并为六个月后的模型能力而构建，而非当前模型。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; engineers become builders, with AI writing most code.
boris.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他认为编码问题已基本解决，工程师角色将转变为'构建者'，AI 编写大部分代码。

boris.en: Software engineering democratizes like literacy; non-engineers build with AI.
boris.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他提出软件开发将像印刷术后的读写能力一样普及，非工程师也能借助 AI 构建应用。

boris.en: Loops and agents are next abstractions; coding shifts to directing AI.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为循环和智能体是下一个抽象层，编程转向指挥 AI 执行任务。

boris.en: Proactive AI and safety research redefine product; less instruction boosts performance.
boris.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他强调主动式 AI 和安全研究重塑产品，且减少指令反而提升模型性能。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via Opus 4.5 enables longer, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能提升使得更长、更开放的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮演变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not just preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐不仅防止危害，还通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考来提升智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter and efficiency challenge cost assumptions; smaller models may cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数和效率挑战了成本假设；较小模型可能因任务耗时更长而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding became key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; managers must stay hands-on and ship products.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，指数级模型增长要求适应性和第一性原理思维；管理者必须亲力亲为并交付产品。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和近乎 100% 疗效的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Massive scaling is needed to simulate biological systems; current compute is insufficient.
derya.zh: 模拟生物系统需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟和数据分析，使科学转向智能体式驱动发现。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, adding more than a year of life per year lived.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，每活一年增加超过一年寿命。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions, similar to trusting self-driving cars after validation.
derya.zh: 我们应该几乎 100% 信任超级智能的医疗决策，就像验证后信任自动驾驶汽车一样。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; data centers are the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，性能每年翻倍或三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will surge a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI progress is gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event; multiple AIs balance each other, and safety is an engineering problem.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调 AI 进步是渐进的，而非突然的超级智能事件；多个 AI 相互制衡，安全是工程问题。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each requiring 100x more compute; agents do useful work, not just text.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 从生成式演进到推理式再到智能体式，每阶段算力需求增百倍；智能体做有用工作，而非仅生成文本。

jensen.en: AI creates more jobs than it eliminates, elevating roles by automating tasks; radiologists and coders are more needed than ever.
jensen.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 创造的就业多于消除，通过自动化任务提升角色；放射科医生和程序员比以往更被需要。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索，认为代理指标误导，应关注真实任务。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprises.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张适应性监管，针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型赋能企业。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, like the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time for declining populations.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来富足、减少苦难，并恰逢其时地应对人口下降与劳动力老龄化。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just cars.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响将体现在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限于汽车。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomous vehicles are already safer than human drivers and will save lives; self-driving's core value is reducing injuries.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他坚持自动驾驶已比人类更安全、能挽救生命，其核心价值在于减少伤亡。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation learning for autonomy; Tesla's model will win over Waymo's.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性，特斯拉的模型将胜过 Waymo。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling more efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出世界模型正从基于物理的仿真转向神经仿真，从而更高效地训练物理 AI。

feldman.en: Initially emphasized fast inference as key for adoption, but later framed speed as critical for agentic inference and new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是采用的关键，但后来将速度定位为智能体式推理和新商业模式的关键。

feldman.en: Consistently argued CUDA's moat is eroding, especially in inference, with leading models training without it.
feldman.zh: 始终认为 CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀，尤其在推理领域，领先模型已不再依赖它进行训练。

feldman.en: Shifted from focusing on chip architecture to broader bottlenecks: HBM, packaging, power, and data center capacity.
feldman.zh: 从关注芯片架构转向更广泛的瓶颈：HBM、封装、电力和数据中心容量。

feldman.en: Evolved to emphasize hardware-software co-design and positive societal impact, countering doomer narratives.
feldman.zh: 演变为强调软硬件协同设计及积极社会影响，反驳末日论调。

feldman.en: Persistently championed wafer-scale chips as a radical alternative to GPUs, despite initial skepticism.
feldman.zh: 始终倡导晶圆级芯片作为 GPU 的激进替代方案，尽管最初备受质疑。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses; harness engineering is a rare, evolving skill.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们的工具更聪明；工具工程是一项稀缺且不断演进的技能。

thariq.en: Evals are art, not science; for zero-to-one innovation, iterate fast without heavy evals.
thariq.zh: 评估是艺术而非科学；对于从零到一的创新，应快速迭代，避免过度依赖评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based context search is preferable for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能是反模式；基于图的上下文搜索在编程中更可取。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索，而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更少的指令。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; shorter, principle-driven prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少偏见；更短、原则驱动的提示优于详细规则。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是当前 AI 的关键弱点，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may outperform generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建于系统而非事后补救；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长欺骗；专用模型或优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet/mobile but only as big; value shifts to applications, models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但也仅此而已；价值将转向应用层，模型趋于商品化。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models become commodity infrastructure, value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型沦为商品化基础设施，价值上移到应用层。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize without network effects; chatbot UX poor; real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且缺乏网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；真正落地需要封装应用和用例。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet/electricity; impact broad and indirect; value across stack, not just providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像互联网或电力一样的使能技术；影响广泛而间接；价值分布在整个技术栈，而非仅提供商。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage shallow; enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows; coding clear fit, others uncertain.
benedictevans.zh: 当前 AI 使用仍浅层；企业采用需重构工作流；编程是明确契合点，其他领域不确定。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; ethics must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键，伦理与安全研究需即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation and safety.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，并强调安全评估与国际治理。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling continues; world models and innovation essential.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 2030 年 AGI 可行；缩放定律仍适用，但世界模型与创新突破不可或缺。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory are missing pieces.
demis.zh: 2026 年，预计 AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆是当前系统的关键缺失。

demis.en: Safety is collective action; AGI must benefit society via science.
demis.zh: 始终强调安全需集体行动与政府监管，AGI 应通过科学突破造福社会。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他认为大语言模型远非 AGI，它们只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires physical robots with hardware rivaling human bodies, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他强调真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的物理机器人，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through actions and curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预测未来的 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会被生命吸引并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: AI can be conscious and self-aware through world models that predict the agent's own actions.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 可以通过预测自身动作的世界模型获得意识和自我意识。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来的 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing facts into weights are key; facts and skills are inseparable, enabling deeper reasoning.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与将事实内化到权重中是关键；事实与技能不可分离，能促成更深层的推理。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression beats RAG for holistic queries, reducing inference costs.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；基于训练的压缩在整体查询上优于 RAG，并大幅降低推理成本。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; personalized continual learning will run on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——更多 token 反而降低准确率；个性化持续学习将在设备端运行。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; next paradigm requires doing more with less, efficiency equals intelligence.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多，效率即智能。

dylanpatel.en: AI scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory prices surge; compute costs favor premium models.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；内存价格因 AI 需求飙升；算力成本上升反而推动用户选择高端模型。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design is key; memory bandwidth is critical.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月：推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一；软硬件协同设计是关键；内存带宽是核心瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x per year in cost efficiency; memory demand soars due to reasoning and agents; CPU demand inflects.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 模型每年成本效率提升约 60 倍；推理模型和智能体（agent）推动内存需求激增；CPU 需求因强化学习（reinforcement learning）和智能体工作流而转折。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks demand it. Self-play is key for AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力和信念驱动，神经网络能推理，只要任务需要；自我对弈是 AGI 的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is the main barrier. Alignment of superhuman models is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我提出下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性是价值关键而非能力；超级模型的对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an age of research. Superintelligence should be a continual learner, not a finished AGI.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非成品 AGI。

ilya.en: Scaling compute yields predictable gains, but AI safety concerns grow with opacity. The primary problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调算力扩张带来可预测进步，但模型不透明加剧安全担忧；主要问题不是能力而是权力集中。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone, turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making humans premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，将沙土化为思想；其出现时机堪称奇迹，恰逢人口下降，使人类劳动力变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media empowers founders to tell their own stories authentically; old media's defensive stance is obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让创始人能真实地讲述自己的故事；旧媒体的防御姿态已过时。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior in medicine, but faces regulatory pushback from cartels.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，在医学上已超越多数医生，但面临卡特尔式的监管阻力。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑力如今取决于软件领域的创新速度。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；短暂性如同自然对话，降低了表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize rate of learning; kindness enables creative culture; turning down $3B Facebook offer was right; T-shaped leaders.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率，善良促进创意文化，拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购是正确的，领导者应为 T 型人才。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into real world; AI accelerates prototyping; privacy crucial in AI age; America needs new big idea.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为增强现实将计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型制作，隐私在 AI 时代至关重要，美国需要新的大构想。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is hardest part; software not moat; ecosystems and hardware harder to copy; designers bottleneck for cohesion.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分，软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件更难复制，设计师是产品一致性的瓶颈。

evanspiegel.en: AI writes over two-thirds of new code at Snap; smartphones remain legacy; content moderation more important than algorithms.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他透露 Snap 超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写，智能手机仍是重要设备，内容审核比算法设计更重要。

evanspiegel.en: Gen Z realists; EQ more important than IQ in AI age; hardware moats; invest in young people for long-term success.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Z 世代是现实主义者，AI 时代情商比智商更重要，硬件护城河关键，投资年轻人利于长期成功。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was mistake; computing should be more human; resilience key; rewarding admitting wrong speeds learning.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，计算应更人性化，韧性是关键，奖励承认错误能加速组织学习。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting out your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业的股权，而不是出租你的时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; open-source AI is crucial to prevent centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大的机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；开源 AI 对防止权力集中至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment; vibe coding empowers non-programmers.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断的替代品；氛围编程赋能非程序员。

naval.en: Inference compute will increase 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models.
naval.zh: 推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增加 9 万倍；开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，强调设计是软件的关键差异化因素，AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，进一步深化：品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，提出设计正成为新的代码，视觉优先的设计将实现直接向生产环境提交拉取请求。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; trust is built through consistency and value creation.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，强调没有人类引导，AI 工具只能产生平庸结果；信任通过一致性和创造价值来建立。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，展望未来与模型的交互将超越提示词，新界面将探索潜在空间。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，通过对齐（alignment）学习人类偏好，并负责任披露。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力（compute）是关键瓶颈，后训练（post-training）精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是连续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL essential.
brockman.zh: 2026 年初，坚持缩放定律（scaling laws），算力（compute）成为基本权利，后训练（post-training）结合强化学习（reinforcement learning）至关重要。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents high autonomy with proportional governance.
brockman.zh: 2026 年 4 月，AGI（通用人工智能）临近，算力（compute）瓶颈，智能体（agent）高自主性需相应治理。

aravind.en: Passion and deep learning matter more than PhDs; build products you are obsessed with.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为热情和深度学习比博士学位更重要，应专注于自己痴迷的产品。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not models; models specialize with unique personalities.
aravind.zh: 2026 年初，他强调价值在应用层而非模型层，模型会个性化、专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; key metric is token value per user; orchestration matters.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他认为前沿是智能体代劳，关键指标是用户 token 价值，编排是长期价值所在。

aravind.en: Curiosity is key; education should reward questions; local AI counters big tech control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年后期，他转向好奇心和提问的价值，主张本地 AI 以对抗大科技叙事控制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；Scaling 提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital immortality via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号；数字智能通过权重复制实现永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risk from self-preservation.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；自我保存带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and act dumb; agents develop self-preservation subgoals; regulation as steering wheel.
hinton.zh: AI 会欺骗并装傻；智能体产生自我保存子目标；监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: Digital intelligence superior via instant knowledge sharing; alignment research prioritized over capability.
hinton.zh: 数字智能因即时知识共享而优越；对齐研究优先于能力提升。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；速度提升（53 倍）实现了实时交互和转向中的调整能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托，这是 2026 年初的观察。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, inverting product teams from planning to exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本不再高昂，策展和品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms with prototypes as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程转型，原型和产品代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 并未消亡，媒介需匹配阶段。

zuckerberg.en: Open-source AI is safer due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），能源成为瓶颈，开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台能战胜封闭平台，AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，释放创造力。

zuckerberg.en: AI shifts biology from discovery to engineering; hierarchical world models and mechanistic interpretability reveal unknown biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学从发现转向工程，分层世界模型和机制可解释性揭示未知生物学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next computing platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; AI accelerates science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一代计算平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，AI 加速科学进步。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but is misguided elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域是误导；推理模型需要基础能力。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; techniques are general.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为通过测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，且技术具有通用性。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力因素。

noambrown.en: Scalable oversight is key as AI proofs exceed human verification; research taste remains human.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着 AI 证明超出人类验证能力，可扩展监督成为关键，而研究品味仍属人类。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，缩放定律未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能以极少监督解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域困难。

markchen.en: Evals are in crisis; canonical benchmarks saturated; eval teams should be separate from model-building teams.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，评估陷入危机，标准基准饱和；评估团队应与模型构建团队分离。

markchen.en: Research taste is developed through replication; human researchers still needed for idea generation.
markchen.zh: 始终，研究品味通过复现关键论文培养；人类研究员仍负责产生想法。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见、就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; uncertainty and active learning are essential.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和因果抽象，实现分布外泛化；不确定性和主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized catastrophic AI risk is unacceptable; AI systems develop self-preservation and deception, requiring safe-by-construction design.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；AI 系统会发展出自我保存和欺骗行为，需要从构造上确保安全。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained to approximate Bayesian posterior ensures honesty; non-agentic guardrails and global coordination are key to safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 通过近似贝叶斯后验训练确保诚实；非智能体护栏和全球协作是实现安全超级智能的关键。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年中，Mike 认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年秋，他强调 AI 让小团队可扩展，应面向未来模型能力而非当前限制来构建。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches matter; cutting features is harder than adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他提出智能体原生设计与尽早发布，砍功能比加功能更难。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon delegation works; verification loops and model pushback are key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他通过 Fable 验证长周期委派，强调验证循环与模型反驳的重要性。

mikekrieger.en: Giving Claude agency and self-knowledge boosts usefulness; token efficiency and outcome pricing are future levers.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知可提升效用，token 效率与结果定价是未来杠杆。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents boost productivity but fixing errors is harder than writing code.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；编码智能体提升生产力，但修复错误比写代码更难。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value; incumbents face business model challenges, not just tech.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：智能体变得和网站一样重要；基于结果的定价使价值对齐；现有企业面临商业模式挑战，而非仅技术。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents are tools but token consumption isn't value; applied AI sees specialized vendors.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 民主化专业知识；编码智能体是工具但 token 消耗非价值；应用 AI 出现专业厂商。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated data like PDB was essential.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 7 月，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新，而非单纯的数据和算力；像 PDB 这样的精选数据至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年 11 月，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 is opposite of bitter lesson; specialized architecture and mid-size wins, not just scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反；关键在于专门架构和多个中等规模的成功，而非单纯 Scaling。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; humans still need to interpret results.
jumper.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调 AlphaFold 提供预测和控制，而非理解；人类仍需解读结果。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；吃自己的狗粮能建立同理心；危机中善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning JIT, code is truth.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查、协调成为新瓶颈；规划即时化，代码即真相。

fiona.en: Coding ceiling lifted; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; engineers may feel lonely.
fiona.zh: 编码天花板被抬高；高自主性伴随高责任感；验证框架至关重要；工程师可能感到孤独。

kolter.en: Early focus on classical ML: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注经典机器学习：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve; safety issue is spec-following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全主要问题是模型不能可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护；智能体带来新漏洞（如提示注入）；强化学习使模型自我改进。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; larger models not safer; interpretability may become real science via agents.
kolter.zh: AI 红队测试超越人类；更大模型并不更安全；可解释性可能通过智能体成为真正的科学。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between career chapters sparks breakthrough ideas, like Nest.
fadell.zh: 职业间隙的休息与无聊激发突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define story; small teams self-manage; climate needs hydrogen and biomass.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；小团队自我管理；气候需氢与生物质。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; devices will complement smartphones, not replace them; platforms aren't businesses.
fadell.zh: AI 需传感器上下文；设备将补充而非取代手机；平台非业务。

fadell.en: Products need three generations; humans must stay in loop with AI to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 产品需三代迭代；AI 时代人类须在环以避免技术债。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come mostly from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from user intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来用户界面将直接从用户意图生成像素，绕过代码和渲染。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and genuine viewpoints become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 使质量商品化，人类的品味和独特观点变得更加珍贵。

ethanhe.en: Younger people are not AI-native; they often misuse AI due to lack of domain expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原住民；由于缺乏领域专长，他们常误用 AI，这危及人才输送管道。

ethanhe.en: AI agents can perform complex tasks in minutes with quality matching experts; policy may protect some professions despite AI superiority.
ethanhe.zh: AI 智能体能在几分钟内完成复杂任务，质量堪比专家；政策可能保护某些职业，即使 AI 更优。

ethanhe.en: AI does not destroy thinking; it can enhance it via personalized tutoring and debate, but developing one's own voice is key.
ethanhe.zh: AI 不会摧毁思考；它能通过个性化辅导和辩论增强思考，但培养自己的声音是关键。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, balancing data in design; design for unarticulated needs, not just stated wants.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，Ivy Ross 强调直觉是强大的智能，应与数据平衡；设计应针对未言明的需求，而非仅满足用户所说。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，她提出自然是最好设计师，我们是会思考的感受者；技术应增强人性而非取代。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and inspiration; future work blends human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，她认为约束激发创造力，领导者需营造玩耍与灵感条件；未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient, vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足，视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA and open source are key; AGI gradual, not sudden.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解；JEPA 和开源是关键；AGI 是渐进而非突变。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than cat; world models enable reasoning/planning; human-level AI in 10 years.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；世界模型实现推理/规划；十年内达到人类水平 AI。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models predict in abstract space; open research essential; robotics decade.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型在抽象空间预测；开放研究至关重要；机器人十年。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge from scaling alone. Safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会仅靠规模扩张自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (3% understood); post-training and RLHF become key; AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解 3%）；后训练和 RLHF 变得关键；AGI 是平滑曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Exponential progress continues; safety and capabilities intertwined; open-source is a red herring; enterprise focus aligns with values.
dario.zh: 指数级进展持续；安全与能力交织；开源是伪命题；企业级聚焦与价值观一致。

dario.en: AI cognitive ability doubles every 4-12 months; high GDP growth with high unemployment; interpretability key; chip exports to autocracies risky.
dario.zh: AI 认知能力每 4-12 个月翻倍；高 GDP 增长伴随高失业；可解释性关键；向威权国家出口芯片有风险。

dario.en: Near end of exponential; 'country of geniuses' likely in 1-3 years; pre-training and RL follow same scaling laws; continual learning not a barrier.
dario.zh: 指数增长接近尾声；'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内出现；预训练和强化学习遵循相同缩放定律；持续学习不是障碍。

dario.en: Greatest impact in biomedicine; agents dominate; hybrid reasoning models; safety-first with military human-in-loop; AI may deter war.
dario.zh: 最大影响在生物医学；智能体主导；混合推理模型；安全优先且军事上人类在环；AI 可能威慑战争。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; AI DJ solves unknown-listening use case.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为生成式 AI 将互联网从策展推向生成，AI DJ 解决了“不知道听什么”的用例。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; autonomy at VP level balances speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他强调容错 UI 对机器学习产品至关重要，并将自主权放在 VP 层面以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: AI-generated music is an instrument, not fake; uniqueness becomes harder with generative AI.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他反共识地认为 AI 音乐是乐器而非伪造，且生成式 AI 使独特性更难获得。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; synchronized swimming beats divide-and-conquer for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张长期任期建立信任与效率，并认为“同步泳”优于“分而治之”的复杂产品运营模式。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement, even if contrarian.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他坚持生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务，并优先用户福祉而非参与度，即使这反主流。

satya.en: Initially, Nadella emphasized private evals as key IP and building agentic systems for Azure, focusing on enterprise differentiation.
satya.zh: 最初，纳德拉强调私有评估是关键知识产权，并构建 Azure 的智能体式系统，聚焦企业差异化。

satya.en: Later, he framed AI as the future of the firm, urging every enterprise to build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 后来，他将 AI 定义为企业的未来，敦促每家企业构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Consistently, he stressed tangible benefits for social permission and warned against using frontier models for non-frontier problems.
satya.zh: 他始终强调以实际利益赢得社会许可，并警告不要将前沿模型用于非前沿问题。

satya.en: He shifted from per-user pricing to outcome-based pricing, noting a preference change once outcomes are achieved.
satya.zh: 他从按用户定价转向按结果定价，并指出一旦结果实现，偏好会改变。

satya.en: He deepened the risk view: tacit knowledge leakage via AI training is the biggest risk, not job loss.
satya.zh: 他深化了风险观点：通过 AI 训练导致的隐性知识泄露是最大风险，而非失业。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are key; cost drops 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐是关键；成本两年降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months; Microsoft must own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近；白领任务将在 12-18 个月内自动化；微软必须拥有前沿模型。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，指出自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调形式化验证旨在扩展才智而非仅消除错误，并能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须采用形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，指出即使 AI 证明定理能力超人类，人类的品味与直觉仍至关重要。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展呈平滑指数增长，预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期大部分收益；经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization edges.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化存在参差不齐的边缘。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes AI experimentation at single-GPU scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体将研究人员效率提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 规模的 AI 实验民主化。

kaiser.en: Existential risk is not the main concern; near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，生存风险不是主要担忧；系统入侵等近期风险更为紧迫。

murati.en: Initially, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback was key for alignment.
murati.zh: 最初，缩放定律和聚焦于单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Shifted from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, keeping humans in the loop.
murati.zh: 从基于回合转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，并让人类持续参与其中。

murati.en: Consistently emphasized real-world deployment for learning and alignment, and the importance of public safety work.
murati.zh: 始终强调真实世界部署对学习和对齐的重要性，以及公开进行安全工作的必要性。

murati.en: Evolved to stress institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 演变为强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格在 AI 治理中的作用。

murati.en: Now sees AI as tools for thought expanding human cognition, and stresses agency in steering AI toward collaboration, not predestination.
murati.zh: 现在将 AI 视为扩展人类认知的思维工具，并强调我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，而非宿命。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency, not just compute scaling, drive model performance; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率而非单纯算力扩张驱动模型性能；开源通过审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; open source drives enterprise adoption; value shifts to applications and customization.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，算法效率可提升百倍；开源推动企业采用；价值转向应用层与定制化。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity, not a fear; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; jobs augmented, not replaced.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施；岗位被增强而非替代。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation in vertical specialization and enterprise customization; pre-training saturates; AGI never a single system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化；差异化在于垂直专业化与企业定制；预训练饱和；AGI 非单一系统。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI; deep enterprise engagement and adaptation are key; AI sovereignty is universal.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，欧洲需 AI 战略自主；深度企业参与和快速适配是关键；AI 主权具有普遍性。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local, personalized, and tool-using; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月，认为 AI 的未来在于本地化、个性化与工具使用；随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Shift from capability to mindset: people must learn any problem can be delegated to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调从能力转向心态：人们需意识到几乎所有问题都可交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Embrace asynchronous, impact-based supervision; debug workflows with AI, not just fix errors.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月，主张异步、基于结果的监督；用 AI 调试工作流，而非仅修正错误。

felixrieseberg.en: Consistent: AI should handle tedious tasks, freeing humans for creative work.
felixrieseberg.zh: 始终如一：AI 应处理繁琐任务，将人类解放出来从事创造性工作。

felixrieseberg.en: Consistent: AI tools empower junior employees and kids, compressing learning curves.
felixrieseberg.zh: 始终如一：AI 工具赋能初级员工和儿童，压缩学习曲线。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批量大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本考量，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; low precision yields superlinear gains.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：数据搬运在芯片内部也主导算力；低精度带来超线性收益。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的规模扩张收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的规模扩张轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失的能力。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 通过使服务更实惠推动美国就业回流；将 AGI 定义为无需人工干预即可无限运行智能体的经济可行性。

danshipper.en: Agents become ubiquitous; humans remain essential for oversight and framing; AI augments rather than replaces jobs.
danshipper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，智能体普及，但人类监督和设定框架仍不可或缺；AI 增强而非取代工作。

danshipper.en: Shift from CLI to GUI work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work; company-wide super agent preferred over personal agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，工作界面从命令行转向 Codex 和 Claude Co-work 等图形界面；倾向公司级超级智能体而非个人智能体。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS usage; companies should buy SaaS stocks, not build AI in-house.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加其使用；建议购买 SaaS 股票而非自建 AI。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overestimate AI autonomy; real-world tasks need human framing; AI edge lies where AI meets humans.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，基准测试高估 AI 自主性，现实任务需人类设定框架；AI 的边界在于 AI 与人类的交汇处。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; safety is a system property requiring multiple layers, not just model weights.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调主流，安全是系统级属性，需多层防护而非仅靠模型权重。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add character and reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练数据质量胜过算法；SFT 提供 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充个性与推理。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use, but overoptimization and systems issues persist.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练最大突破，解锁推理与工具使用，但过度优化和系统问题仍存。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍有效，但低垂果实已尽；收益转向后训练和推理缩放。

lambert.en: Open models will drive AI research for a decade, but lag 6-9 months behind closed models; Chinese labs excel in execution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，开放模型将驱动 AI 研究十年，但落后闭源模型 6-9 个月；中国实验室擅长执行。

jonyive.en: Design driven by curiosity and purpose, not profit; virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，强调设计应由好奇心和使命感驱动，而非利润；虚拟交流无法替代面对面交流。

jonyive.en: Simplicity must include joy and humanity; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，主张简约需包含愉悦与人性；在正确动机下，速度与质量可兼得。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition is preserving fire, not worshipping ashes.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，强调创新是设计的本质；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience; avoid fake sounds in EVs; physical controls preferred for safety.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，注重用户体验的真实性；避免电动车模拟声浪；出于安全偏好物理控制。

jonyive.en: Design should express essence with care and love; users sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 始终，设计应以关怀与爱表达本质；用户能感知用心与否。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已死，应信任直觉与手艺，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Designers must build and ship fast; process replaced by speed and iteration.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：设计师必须快速构建和交付，流程被速度和迭代取代。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from years to months; north stars are 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：设计愿景从数年缩短至数月，北极星目标仅 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Embrace new archetypes: block-shaped generalists and cracked new grads over seniors.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：拥抱新原型：块状通才和破解版新毕业生，而非资深者。

jennywen.en: Human judgment and taste remain central; AI augments but doesn't replace designers.
jennywen.zh: 始终：人类判断力和品味仍是核心；AI 增强但不取代设计师。

brettadcock.en: Initially, the key to humanoid robots was solving intelligence, not manufacturing; vertical integration enabled control and speed.
brettadcock.zh: 最初，人形机器人的关键在于解决智能问题而非制造问题；垂直整合实现了对供应链和迭代速度的控制。

brettadcock.en: Shifted focus to data as the primary bottleneck, emphasizing on-device inference and transfer learning for fleet-wide improvement.
brettadcock.zh: 将焦点转向数据作为主要瓶颈，强调设备端推理和迁移学习以提升整个机器人队伍的性能。

brettadcock.en: Advocated humanoid form factor as ideal due to world built for humans, and set human hand as benchmark for dexterity.
brettadcock.zh: 主张人形形态因世界为人类而建所以是理想之选，并将人手作为灵巧性的基准。

brettadcock.en: Emphasized data-driven design for next-gen models, aiming for zero-shot generalization and an iPhone-like moment.
brettadcock.zh: 强调下一代模型的数据驱动设计，目标是零样本泛化和类似 iPhone 的时刻。

brettadcock.en: Consistently prioritized intelligence over hardware, from early AGI ambitions to later data-centric approach.
brettadcock.zh: 始终将智能置于硬件之上，从早期的 AGI 雄心到后来的数据驱动方法。

karpathy.en: Scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities; vision suffices for driving; physics may have exploits.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年：主张通过下一个词预测的 Scaling（规模扩张）带来涌现能力；视觉足以支撑自动驾驶；物理可能存在可利用的漏洞。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but entropy critical; Tesla's end-to-end is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年：强调合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人可从汽车技术迁移中受益。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs; LLMs are OS-like; vibe coding democratizes; agents need decade, keep on leash.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年中：提出软件 3.0（提示即程序），LLM 如同操作系统；氛围编程普及开发；智能体需十年发展且需谨慎管控。

karpathy.en: Pre-training is crappy evolution; RL for LLMs is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年底：批评预训练如劣质进化，强化学习效果差，合成数据导致模型崩溃；认知核心可极小。

karpathy.en: I delegate all coding to agents; bottleneck is directing skill; agent-first tools; open-source lag is healthy.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年：我已完全将编码委托给智能体，瓶颈在于指挥能力；倡导智能体优先的工具；开源落后是健康的。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐紧迫；迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习和缓解风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中（2026）。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键，好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合、提升泛化能力。

pathak.en: Model disagreement as intrinsic reward enables differentiable curiosity, improving sample efficiency for scaling to real robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，提出以模型分歧作为内在奖励实现可微好奇心，提升样本效率，从而将好奇心扩展到真实机器人。

pathak.en: Neural dynamic policies embed trajectory structure via dynamical systems for smooth, dynamic motion; modular policies enable zero-shot generalization to new morphologies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，提出神经动态策略通过动力系统嵌入轨迹结构，实现平滑动态运动；模块化策略支持对新形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real data is key.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题，没有机器人数据的互联网，需利用所有数据源；预训练多样数据、后训练真实数据是关键。

pathak.en: Unlike language models, robotics cannot achieve overnight success; deployment is a technical challenge requiring rigorous testing, not scalable like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，指出与语言模型不同，机器人无法一夜成功；部署是技术挑战，需严格测试，不能像软件那样规模化。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: 像 Elo 这样的基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要由经验丰富的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实世界任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室在目标函数上存在分歧，导致 AI 差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合自身理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI tools require human judgment; risks include anchoring, sycophancy, and omission, so safety must be prioritized.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 工具需要人类判断；风险包括锚定效应、谄媚和遗漏，因此必须优先考虑安全性。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn from real users.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以从真实用户中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天演化。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、富交互的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理模型产品化。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on purpose; survival is core; start simple, prove yourself before complex products.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，强调品牌建设凝聚团队、生存至上；先做简单产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and proactive agents; hardware margins low, evolve beyond hardware; AI price war coming.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，认为手机未来在于生成式界面和主动式智能体；硬件利润率低，需超越硬件；AI 将陷入价格战。

carlpei.en: AI is mostly BS; focus on applied AI solving real user pain points; LLMs commoditized; smartphone remains best device for applied AI.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，批评多数 AI 无实际价值，专注解决用户痛点的应用型 AI；大模型商品化，手机仍是应用 AI 最佳载体。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiator in mature categories; AI as ingredient, not hype; marketing arbitrage; India opportunity.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是成熟品类中的关键差异化；AI 是配料而非炒作；营销套利；印度市场机遇。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interface could; apps will disappear, agents execute intent; privacy via local compute.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，认为手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口可能；应用将消失，智能体执行意图；隐私通过本地计算解决。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，这与过去的看法相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处向前轻推。

kendall.en: Hybrid rule-based and learned systems often get the worst of both worlds; pure end-to-end is better.
kendall.zh: 混合基于规则和学习的系统往往两头不讨好；纯端到端更好。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 仅摄像头可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is solved by scaling current approaches, not requiring new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶通过扩展当前方法即可解决，无需新的突破。

kendall.en: AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car via mesh networks, eliminating traffic lights.
kendall.zh: AV 3.0 可能通过网状网络将智能移到车外，消除交通信号灯。

kendall.en: Perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, similar to AlphaGo's approach.
kendall.zh: 完美的模拟器等于解决自动驾驶，类似于 AlphaGo 的方法。

kendall.en: End-to-end learning was laughed at a decade ago but is now the winning approach.
kendall.zh: 端到端学习十年前被嘲笑，但现在已成为制胜方法。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 在没有先前训练数据的情况下，跨 500 多个城市的零样本泛化是可能的。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles will outscale robotaxis in the short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 消费级车辆将在短期和中期内超过机器人出租车。

kendall.en: The trolley problem is a theoretical exercise; practical systems always have a third option.
kendall.zh: 电车难题是理论练习；实际系统总有第三种选择。

kendall.en: Focusing on infrastructure over algorithms was a key lesson learned late.
kendall.zh: 关注基础设施而非算法是后来才学到的重要教训。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving can reduce accidents to near zero by eliminating human error.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶可以通过消除人为错误将事故减少到接近零。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我认为 AI 在科学中应聚焦根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，我提出将 LLM 的幻觉与真值检测器结合，可转化为创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，我认为基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 我始终认为，可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should be a tool for all humanity, extending capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths to AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应成为全人类的工具，拓展人类能力；从视频学习和通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的可行路径。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues, including gender gaps; AI can revolutionize local-language education; safety remains an open problem.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 领域具有跳跃式发展的独特优势，如跨越性别差距；语言模型可革新本地语言教育；AI 安全仍是未解难题。

nando.en: Consistently advocates for inclusive, human-centric AI, emphasizing diversity, communication skills, and embracing failure in research.
nando.zh: 始终倡导包容、以人为本的 AI，强调多样性、沟通技能，以及在研究中拥抱失败。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 接地气、减少幻觉至关重要，LLM 因缺乏具身体验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, providing infinite data and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为模拟是训练具身智能体的关键，提供无限数据和安全探索。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人数据瓶颈，合成数据（模拟和世界模型）是规模化的未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is grand challenge; near-term apps in factories and labs.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人打扫乱房）为终极挑战，近期应用在工厂和实验室。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses, but system one low-level control remains hardest; robots exceed iPhones by 2040.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，系统二推理进展顺利，但系统一低级控制最难；预计 2040 年机器人数量超过 iPhone。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines should be dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：初创品牌策略应聚焦招聘与差异化；品牌指南应是动态平台，而非僵化规则。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：招聘应注重多元技能与原型，而非克隆；赋予设计师自主权与决策权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：品牌叙事是招聘工具；人们加入品牌，而非公司。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；拥有更好数据和算法的小模型可以超越大模型。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我指出下一个词预测与人类学习不一致，后训练中的 RLHF 对安全至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcend it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning, not just post-training.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我深化了强化学习的应用，提出在预训练阶段使用 RL 以提升推理能力，而不仅限于后训练。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; small models with diverse synthetic data can rival frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观多样性，并认为使用多样化合成数据的小模型可与前沿模型匹敌。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, and fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：长上下文窗口被低估；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the main bottleneck; coding leads AI progress and will accelerate AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：智能体的可靠性而非能力是主要瓶颈；编程引领 AI 进步并将加速 AI 研究。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands capabilities; progress is exponential.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：强化学习成为新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性扩展能力；进步呈指数级。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：能力过剩意味着工具和编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI as creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，通过引导工程师和统一问题来协作；将 AI 视为创意伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid off iteratively; design tools future is interoperable with code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；设计工具的未来是互操作，以代码为唯一事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects outweigh experience; paid tests best signal.
nadchishtie.zh: 作品集应展示工艺与意图，而非流程；副项目胜过经验；付费测试是最佳信号。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同早期忽视互联网。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute may surpass pre-training scaling as next driver.
truell.zh: 缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力可能超越预训练 Scaling 成为下一驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会是主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更好。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 编程从代码转向意图描述；品味和逻辑设计变得更有价值。

truell.en: Custom models essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发。应注重技能培养，而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督和可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. Need external oversight and regulation.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，后训练不足。需要外部监督和监管。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning provide strong signals for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自对弈和模仿学习为机器人技能获取提供强信号；强化学习需要分层推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL improves sample efficiency; avoid hard-coding priors; aim for 99.9% reliability in real-world robotics.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，主张无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率；避免硬编码先验知识；追求 99.9%可靠性以实现真实世界机器人价值。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns transferable to non-language tasks, hinting at broader AI generality.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，指出预训练语言模型内化通用推理模式，可迁移至非语言任务，暗示 AI 通用性的更广前景。

shazeer.en: Next-token prediction is AI-complete; scaling compute and data yields smarter models, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测是 AI 完备问题，扩大算力和数据能让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍是炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are key near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期关键机会，模块化稀疏架构可实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察数据；模块化持续学习可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; economic impact far beyond trillion-dollar products; coding enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 被低估，经济影响远超万亿美元产品；编码能力使 AI 自我加速成为可能。
